newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's ONA Group buys 40 pct of insurance firm.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's ONA Group buys 40 pct of insurance firm.

text.p: Morocco's largest private conglomerate ONA Group purchased 40 percent of leading Compagnie Africaine d'Assurances (CAA), the group said on Monday.
In a statement sent to Reuters, ONA said it purchased a 40 percent stake held earlier by French insurance firm AGF International in Moroccan CAA company.
It gave no indication on the transaction value.
The purchase operation is a part of ONA's strategy aimed at playing an important role in Morocco's insurance market, the statement said.
ONA which already had a stake of 49.45 percent in the firm, now holds 100 percent of CAA capital through its subsidiaries, including Financiere Diwan, it said.

The conglomerate, which holds diversified stakes in more than 80 firms, showed a rise of 45.8 percent in its consolidated net profit to 878.7 million dirhams (94 million) in 1996 compared with the previous year.
The insurance sector represented an average 3.0 percent of Morocco's Gross Domestic Product in 1995, analysts said.
